name: EWA Approximation with Tangent Vector Adjustment
definition: A high-quality filtering technique for point-based rendering that approximates the EWA resampling filter by dynamically adjusting the tangent vectors of isotropic splats during setup to prevent aliasing during minification, without requiring expensive per-fragment convolution.
summary: EWA Approximation with Tangent Vector Adjustment is a high-quality point-based rendering technique that prevents aliasing by dynamically adjusting splat tangents, avoiding expensive per-fragment convolution.
